purpose: Record the natural W1L1 contact case for authored tile 0x29/41, whose descriptor word includes the 0x40 alignment bit.

method.route: 21 KBD_right:30 phases, then KBD_right+KBD_space+KBD_up:30, then WAIT:1 phases

ascent_crossing.interpretation: The player has passed upward through the tile-41 structure; the route was unpatched and no blocked-ascent response occurred at this crossing.

confirmed: An unpatched W1L1 route crosses authored tile 0x29/41 upward and later lands on the same tile family during descent.
The landing correction reads descriptor word 0x0050 through 5CC3 and leaves the player grounded with zero vertical velocity.
The authored tile-41 case is traversable from below and supports a descending contact response while the descriptor 0x40 alignment bit is present.
not_yet_proven: A general one-way rule for every descriptor with bit 0x20 or 0x40.
Natural ceiling behavior for the 41C1/41CF response.
Whether the 0x40 bit alone, rather than the authored tile geometry, determines the observed landing coordinate.

next: Capture the tile-42/43 cases with descriptor words 0x70/0x30 or a natural ceiling to isolate the remaining 0x20 response polarity.
